mapper.select: select p.id, p.contractor_id, p.project_id, p.type_id, p.punish_user, p.money, p.describe, p.punish_time, p.creator, coalesce(d.item_name, p.type_id) as type_name, pr.proj_name from cbs.t_contractor_punish_log p left join cbs.t_dict d on d.item_id = p.type_id and d.dict_type = 'penalty_type' left join cbs.t_project pr on pr.project_id = p.project_id where p.open_status = true and p.contractor_id = #{contractorId} order by p.punish_time desc, p.create_time desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from cbs.t_contractor_punish_log where open_status = true and contractor_id = #{contractorId}
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_contractor_punish_log (id, contractor_id, project_id, type_id, punish_user, money, describe, punish_time, creator) values (#{p.id}, #{p.contractor_id}, #{p.project_id}, #{p.type_id}, #{p.punish_user}, #{p.money}, #{p.describe}, #{p.punish_time}, #{p.creator})
